resources.string: Your mosque\'s adhan and iqamah times from Masjidbox or Mawaqit, with the next prayer highlighted

Type your mosque\'s name and tap Find. Add the town if the name is common (e.g. Masjid Al Falah Coventry). The best match is picked for you, and you can tap another if it\'s wrong. Mosques on Masjidbox and Mawaqit both work. You can also paste a link to the mosque\'s Masjidbox or Mawaqit page, or pick one you\'ve used before.
Looking for “%1$s” on Mawaqit and Masjidbox…
No mosque found for “%1$s”. Try a shorter name or add the town, or paste the link to its Masjidbox or Mawaqit page.

A soft outline round the text, for see-through widgets and busy pictures.
Pick one, or type any Google Fonts name (e.g. the one you chose for the TV) and press Done. Arabic names use the phone\'s Arabic font.
None: the glass sits straight on your wallpaper.
Pick a colour. \"Phone theme\" follows your wallpaper colours.
Only used when the mosque\'s web page lists adhan times but not iqamah (e.g. Chingford Mosque).
Lets the highlight and countdown switch over exactly at each adhan and iqamah. Without it, Android may update the widget a few minutes late.

To add a widget: long-press an empty space on your home screen, tap Widgets, find Iqama Times and drag it on. Make it one row high for just the times, or two rows for the countdown banner. Tap a widget to change its mosque. You can add several widgets for different mosques.
